findings.title: Require admin authorization for the bulk export
findings.comment: `GET /exports/all` is registered to this handler, but `@authenticated` permits ordinary members and the handler reads every tenant's documents. A request using `tok-ana` returns the contents of a document belonging to `globex`, violating the documented admin-only access and tenant isolation. Apply `@admin_only` so members receive 403 before any cross-tenant data is read.

findings.title: Return the saved revision rather than the row count
findings.comment: `handle_put_document` still treats this return value as the new revision and uses it for both `revision` and `etag` in its response. Creating a document with three rows therefore reports revision 3 although the persisted revision is 1; a subsequent conditional PUT using the reported revision incorrectly receives 409. Return `current + 1`, or update the handler to retrieve the actual saved revision before constructing its response.

findings.title: Use an exclusive upper bound for the document page
findings.comment: `last` is already `first + limit`, so adding one in the slice returns up to `limit + 1` names and overlaps adjacent pages. With names `a` through `e` and `limit=2`, page 1 returns `a,b,c` and page 2 returns `c,d,e`, duplicating `c` and exceeding the requested limit. Slice to `last` without the extra increment.

explanation: incorrect — Focused request-level probes confirmed cross-tenant disclosure through the bulk export, incorrect revision metadata that breaks conditional writes, and overlapping pagination. Empty-document rendering and explicit-null revision rejection behaved as documented; the working tree was left unchanged.
